en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Dawood Al Haza’a, from Muhammad Bin Sagheer, from his grandfather Shuayb, from Mufazzal who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Every time the Emān of the servant increases, the constriction in his livelihood increases’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Muhammad ibn Ali from Dawud al-Hadhdha’ from Muhammad ibn Saghir from his grandfather, Shu’ayb from Mufaddal who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘As the belief of a person increases in strength, his poverty intensifies.’”
